veranderings.rede: 'reis terug' after the noun is elliptical and wooden; the compound 'terugreis' is the natural Afrikaans form.

veranderings.blok: Min plek en werk in wagte
veranderings.voor: Die seemanne het onder die dek gewoon en daar was
veranderings.na: Die seemanne het onder die dek gewoon, en daar was
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Min plek en werk in wagte
veranderings.voor: Die werk is in wagte verdeel en so was daar dag en nag hande op die dek.
veranderings.na: Die werk is in wagte verdeel, en so was daar dag en nag seemanne aan diens op die dek.
veranderings.rede: 'hande op die dek' calques English 'hands on deck'; also adds the AWS comma between two full clauses.

veranderings.rede: In a list of general dangers the plural reads naturally; the singular sounds like one specific accident.
'wat kom' is vague and wooden for a definition; 'ontstaan' is precise and suits Grade 6.
'die volgende' without a noun is elliptical; naming 'groep' makes the reference clear in an entry read on its own.
